May 27, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Towercrest Capital Management increased its stake in Ishares Nasdaq Biotechnology Etf (GOOGL) by 200% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Towercrest Capital Management bought 9,742 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.79% with the market. The institutional investor held 14,613 shares of the programming company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.56 million, up from 4,871 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Towercrest Capital Management who had been investing in Ishares Nasdaq Biotechnology Etf for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $750.47B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.13% or $1.37 during the last trading session, reaching $1084.08. About 992,843 shares traded. Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) has risen 20.09% since May 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 8.54% the S&P500.
